heading: Sketch-backed series aggregations
text:
### Sketch-backed series aggregations [LNLS.3.5]

A series declaration that uses an aggregation whose only available
backing is a sketch, with an O(n) worst-case absorb ([LNLS.4.8]), is a
compile error in a program with `linear_scan: false`.

An accuracy phrase never reaches this check: the validator refuses it first
([LSER.15]).

Every aggregation [LSER.16] defines is allowed, the signal-processing set
included —
`active_fraction` (`SeriesBackendIntervalPulse`), `onset_rate` (`SeriesBackendRingBuffer`), and `integral` (`SeriesBackendNumericIntegral`) — all
bounded, non-sketch backings ([LSIG.1.1]).
